Chapter 6059: I Will Never Sell My Lucky Cat

Chapter 6059: I Will Never Sell My Lucky Cat

Killing Six-style couldn’t be easier, requiring but a finger flick.

“Bring it.” Nevertheless, she didn’t show fear.

“Hahaha, I don’t want to ruin my reputation. Perhaps I should capture and turn you into a slave, never to oppose me again.” He laughed and nodded: “Yes, this is a good idea. It is an honor to be my slave.

His eyes scanned her up and down, not hiding his perverted intention.

“Enough, go fantasize outside.” Li Qiye yawned and interrupted him.

He took a look at Li Qiye and only saw a feeble mortal.

“Ignorant mortal, you court death.” A Grand Emperor should be benevolent to lesser beings. However, if this mortal wanted to die, he didn’t mind crushing him like an ant.

“Sigh, served on a platter, looks like I can’t refuse.” Li Qiye smiled at the owner: “I will sell him, not pawn. Name a price.”

The owner analyzed Jad-faced and said: “Two dao fruits, they go for ten million each so twenty. But, he is alive so I can’t buy him, the rule requires both parties to accept.”

“What about a corpse?” Li Qiye asked.

Jade-faced became livid after hearing their conversation. An emperor with two dao fruits was still an emperor - a superior being or a god looming above everyone.

After all, cultivators could try for a lifetime and never come close to his level. Now, this mortal and ghost spoke without thinking.

“Worm, are you ready to die?!” He shouted and raised one finger to crush the mortal into nothingness.

“Pop!” His finger exploded into a bloody mist instead. He had no time to react to the pain before the rest of his arm dissipated.

“Brat!” The shadow behind him sensed danger and roared, activating his dao power and dao fruits against the mortal.

It was too late and useless for his enemy was Li Qiye. Li Qiye’s palm contained a force comparable to a sun exploding and nullified it entirely.

“Who are you?!” Jade-faced finally realized Li Qiye’s terrifying nature and bellowed.

“Crack!” Li Qiye didn’t answer and snatched the emperor’s two dao fruits, going as far as uprooting his dao foundation.

“No!!!” He screamed with despair as blood splashed outward. This put an end to his cultivation.

“Two supreme dao fruits for sale.” Li Qiye smiled and tossed them at the owner.

“This will do.” The owner nodded repeatedly and said: “Twenty million ghost coins.”

He dared not accept the transaction earlier since the dao fruits belonged to Jade-faced Emperor. However, when Li Qiye took them forcefully, they became his so there was no reason to refuse.

Jade-faced, battered by both injuries and anger, spat out a mouthful of blood as he tried to speak and fell unconscious. The blow was too much for him to handle.

Despite only having two fruits, he was still an emperor with Phantom behind him. Now, his dao foundation had been uprooted, meaning his outcome was the same as Six-style Emperor.

“Here you go.” The owner took out a spatial pouch and swung it to hear the numerous coins clanking.

Although they had a tangible yin affinity, they were still the currency of the ghost market. None would be foolish enough to refuse.

Li Qiye caught the pouch and tossed Jade-faced away. His situation was arguably worse than Six-style.

As he was leaving with Six-style, he stopped and asked: “I’ll buy this if you want to sell.”

“Young Noble, this thing is my livelihood, I won’t sell it, I can’t.” The owner immediately carried the statue away from the entrance.

“It’s that magical?” Six-style stared and didn’t notice anything special. It only made noises when Li Qiye came in.

“Not for sale.” The owner shook his head constantly and said: “I can sell you other things for cheap, just not this one.”

“You know it is not a lucky cat but rather, an imprisoned living person.” Li Qiye said.

“Young Noble, prices are negotiable for everything else but I rather be beaten to death than sell it.” The owner said firmly.
